refusal.unknown: This capability does not exist in this hub.
refusal.moduleNotEnabled: This hub has not turned on this part of your agent.
refusal.moduleNotServing: This part of your agent is not available in this hub right now.
refusal.notEligible: This capability is not offered to you in this hub.
refusal.verifiedCompanyRequired: Only a verified company can use this capability.
refusal.offForHub: This hub has switched this capability off.
refusal.offForPrincipalKind: This hub has switched this capability off for the way you are acting.
refusal.offForPlan: This capability is not part of your plan in this hub.
refusal.paused: The hub has paused this capability. Nothing was sent or changed.
refusal.connectionScope: Your connected assistant was not given access to this capability.

closedDay.skip: Skip days the hub is closed
closedDay.next_open_day: Move to the next open day
closedDay.run: Run even when the hub is closed

approval.ask_first: Ask me the first few times
approval.pre_authorized: Act within the mandate without asking

job.weeklyPlanReview: Weekly review of your project plan
job.turnOnNote: Turning a job on only prepares a mandate for you to confirm. Nothing runs until you confirm it.

status.lapsed: No longer offered by the hub

reason.proposal_superseded: A newer proposal replaced this one.
reason.template_withdrawn: The hub no longer offers this job.
reason.module_not_enabled: The hub turned this part of your agent off.

fire.mandate_inactive: Skipped: the mandate is no longer active
fire.template_withdrawn: Skipped: the hub no longer offers this job

settings.tightenOnly: You can make these stricter than the hub default, never looser than the hub maximum.

admin.previewNote: Counts are shown only for groups of at least 10. The second person approves exactly this preview.
admin.guardRails: No setting can switch off mandates, a person's confirmation for commitments, sanctions screening, restricted places or payment neutrality.
admin.noPerPersonAccess: Administrators manage the agent product for everyone. They never see or change one participant's agent, mandates, settings, goals, jobs or connections.

error.previewStale: The preview is out of date. Draft the policy again to see its current effect.
error.policyUnvalidated: This version was not checked by the agent module registry and cannot be activated.
error.guardRail: This setting would weaken a guard rail that no hub can switch off.
error.widening: A hub can narrow a module, never widen it beyond what the engine ships.

killSwitch.releaseNote: Pausing takes effect at once. Releasing needs a second person and an incident note, and restarts nothing that was stopped.

scope.hub_agent_dispatch: Every agent action in this hub

reasons.manifest_invalid: The manifest is incomplete or inconsistent.
reasons.guard_rail: The manifest has a key that is not allowed. No extension can switch off a guard rail.
reasons.action_without_mandate_kind: Every action must name a mandate kind.
reasons.action_kind_refused: An extension action is a draft or a commitment; reading and governing are not extension actions.
reasons.confirmation_below_built_in: The confirmation is weaker than the built-in action of the same mandate kind.
reasons.capability_invalid: An action breaks a rule that applies to every agent capability.
reasons.restricted_endpoint: An endpoint lies in a restricted place.
reasons.endpoint_undeclared: An action uses an endpoint the manifest does not declare.
reasons.key_reserved: This key belongs to a built-in module.
reasons.charge_without_budget: A charged action needs a mandate kind that spends a budget.
reasons.invalid_transition: This version cannot move to that state.
reasons.revision_conflict: The version changed. Reload it and try again.
reasons.suite_required: Activation needs a safety suite that passed on the fake adapter.
reasons.suite_stale: The safety suite passed on another engine version. Run it again.
reasons.suite_pending: A safety suite of this version is already waiting to run.
reasons.version_not_ready: Only a tested version can be activated.
reasons.route_missing: The extension has no active model route of its own.
reasons.egress_denied: The route would send a data class that the egress rules do not allow.
reasons.price_version_unavailable: A charged action cannot be activated yet: billing cannot confirm its price version.
reasons.drafter_cannot_approve: The person who wrote the manifest cannot be its second person.
reasons.one_version_per_extension: An extension has one active version at a time.
reasons.extension_inactive: This extension is not available in this hub right now.
reasons.version_changed: The extension changed after you approved this action. Nothing was sent.
reasons.input_invalid: The call does not match the inputs this action declares.
reasons.amount_below_cost: The amount does not cover what this action costs.
reasons.output_refused: The extension's answer did not match its contract and was discarded.
reasons.adapter_unavailable: The adapter of this extension is not installed for this connection.
reasons.side_effect_needs_mandate_kind: A declared side effect needs a different mandate kind.
reasons.data_classes_undeclared: An external call must declare the data classes it sends.
reasons.private_class_not_sent: A private data class is not declared among the classes sent.
reasons.extension_not_confirmed: This mandate was not confirmed for what this extension can do in this hub. Confirm a new one.
